pages.name: Production & quality
pages.storyNote: What the plant produced, and what it had to scrap to get there.

visuals.title: Quantity produced
visuals.altText: Total units produced across all batches in the current filter.

visuals.title: Quality pass rate
visuals.altText: Share of quality checks that passed.

visuals.title: Average defect rate
visuals.altText: Mean defect rate across production batches.

visuals.subtext: A line that produces the most is not automatically the best line. Read the defect rate on the same axis before drawing conclusions.

visuals.title: Which product categories drive volume
visuals.altText: Units produced by product category, sorted from most to least.

visuals.title: Do the busiest line types also defect most
visuals.altText: Columns show units produced per production line type against a line showing the average defect rate on a second axis.

visuals.title: Output across production lines
visuals.altText: Units produced by each production line, sorted from most to least.

visuals.title: Where defects are caught
visuals.altText: Defects recorded by quality checks for each product category.

pages.name: Machines & maintenance
pages.storyNote: Which machines cost the most to keep running, and where the alerts come from.

visuals.title: Machines
visuals.altText: Number of machines on the plant floor.

visuals.title: Maintenance cost
visuals.altText: Total maintenance spend across all maintenance orders.

visuals.title: Critical alerts
visuals.altText: Number of alerts raised at critical severity.

visuals.subtext: Maintenance spend is rarely spread evenly. Find the machine types that absorb it before negotiating the next service contract.

visuals.title: Which machine types absorb maintenance spend
visuals.altText: Maintenance cost by machine type, sorted from most to least expensive.

visuals.title: How many machines sit at each criticality level
visuals.altText: Machine count for each criticality level, sorted from most to least.

visuals.title: Which sensor types raise the alerts
visuals.altText: Alert count by sensor type, sorted from most to least.

visuals.title: Maintenance order detail
visuals.altText: Order count and maintenance cost for every machine.
